review_evidence: README presents Fxy as a toy language implemented in Lean specifically so its behavior can also be reasoned about formally.
Reasoning/Defs.lean defines reachability and big-step relations; Reasoning/Consistency.lean and Reasoning/Progression.lean prove execution and progression properties.
Complete proposition scan finds 30 theorem/lemma/example declarations across five files, so the source contains substantive language-semantics/proof content.
summary: Reviewed FxyLang; retain the language implementation together with its checked operational reasoning.
